skill.name: firecrawl-scraper
skill.description: Use Firecrawl for deep web extraction, interactive page scraping, screenshots, PDF parsing, website crawling, and batch URL processing.
skill.summary: Guide Firecrawl workflows for extracting and reviewing content from websites and PDFs.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Both static alerts are false positives. The backticks form a Markdown code fence, and the GitHub URL is a documentation link; no executable code or prompt injection was found.

finding_verdicts.reason: Lines 21-23 are a Markdown fenced installation example; the backticks are delimiters, not Ruby or shell command execution. The file contains no executable script.
Line 31 is a documentation link to the referenced GitHub repository. It does not initiate a network request or transmit data.

content.value_statement: Manual extraction from complex websites is slow and inconsistent. This skill guides Firecrawl-based scraping, crawling, screenshots, and PDF parsing.
actual_capabilities: Identifies Firecrawl as the service for deep web content extraction.
Covers website crawling and batch scraping across multiple URLs.
Supports tasks requiring page clicks, scrolling, and other interactions.
Targets screenshot capture and PDF content parsing workflows.
Provides installation, API key configuration, and conversational usage steps.
limitations: Requires a Firecrawl API key and access to the external service.
Contains no API request examples or detailed parameter guidance.
Installation downloads a community skill from an external repository.
Results depend on website permissions, access controls, and Firecrawl behavior.

use_cases.title: Research Source Collection
use_cases.description: Extract article text and source links from selected pages for structured research notes.

use_cases.title: Interactive Page Inspection
use_cases.description: Capture content and screenshots from pages that require scrolling or clicks.

use_cases.title: Website Content Audits
use_cases.description: Crawl approved domains to compare page copy, product details, and update dates.

prompt_templates.title: Scrape One Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Firecrawl to extract the main text from [URL]. Return headings, paragraphs, and source links.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner extraction from one public page.

prompt_templates.title: Capture a Page Screenshot
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Firecrawl to capture a full-page screenshot of [URL] after scrolling to load all visible content.
prompt_templates.scenario: Visual review of an interactive page.

prompt_templates.title: Parse a PDF
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Firecrawl to parse the PDF at [URL]. Summarize each section and preserve page references.
prompt_templates.scenario: Structured review of a web-hosted document.

prompt_templates.title: Crawl and Compare a Site
prompt_templates.prompt: Crawl [DOMAIN] up to [LIMIT] pages. Compare product claims, pricing, and update dates, then flag conflicting information.

output_examples.input: Extract the main article from the provided news page.
output: Summary: The release adds reporting controls and improves export speed.

output_examples.input: Capture a full-page screenshot after all visible content loads.
output_examples.output: A full-page screenshot is captured after scrolling, with the source URL and capture time recorded.

output_examples.input: Crawl the approved product site and compare pricing pages.
output: Two pages list matching plan prices.
One regional page shows an older update date and different limits.

best_practices: Store the Firecrawl API key in an environment variable.
Confirm crawl scope, page limits, and permitted domains before starting.
Verify extracted facts against source pages when accuracy matters.
anti_patterns: Do not scrape restricted content or bypass access controls.
Do not start broad crawls without page limits or a defined domain scope.
Do not expose API keys in prompts, logs, or shared output.

faq.question: Does this skill require a Firecrawl account?
faq.answer: Yes. You need access to Firecrawl and a configured API key.

faq.question: Can it scrape several URLs?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill explicitly covers batch scraping across multiple URLs.

faq.question: Can it interact with dynamic pages?
faq.answer: It targets workflows that require clicks, scrolling, and other page interactions.

faq.question: Does it support PDF files?
faq.answer: Yes. PDF parsing is one of the stated use cases.

faq.question: Does the skill include detailed API examples?
faq.answer: No. It provides setup guidance and links to an external repository for examples.

faq.question: How should I protect my API key?
faq.answer: Store it in an environment variable and never include it in prompts or shared output.
